notes.title: Updates
notes.content:
Big Hit VR Baseball continues to get better.

[h1]1.0.5[/h1]
[olist]
    [*] Audio settings now persist between game modes and program loads, hit away to your own music without distraction 
    [*] Remove MLB Trademarked term
[/olist]

[h1]1.0.6[/h1]
[olist]
  [*] Address crashes during pitch and swing detection caused by inconsistent Steam Achievement setup. Also mitigate against possible similar situations in future updates.
  [*] Changed the color of some fonts for better legibility
[/olist]

notes.title: Apology and Updates to Fix Launch Issues
notes.content:
Truly sorry about the experience that Big Hit VR Baseball provided at launch. In the rush to implement visual swing feedback before release, the new feature's effect on other systems was overlooked. The decision to try to implement a new feature so close to release was a mistake. It is especially disappointing to let down enthusiastic baseball fans willing to give the game an early chance. Once again, sorry.

A lot of hard work has gone into fixing the unacceptable problems in the initial release as soon as possible, and the latest updates have significantly improved the user experience. Home Run Derby mode is now fully functional, and hit detection - while not perfect - is vastly improved. The plan is to continue to make small QOL updates while also working on new features. 

Your feedback is instrumental to making the best possible baseball game, so thank you to those who voiced concerns.

Here is the list of updates:

[h1]1.0.4[/h1]
[list]
  [*] Fully support Offline Mode
[/list]
[h1]1.0.3[/h1]
[list]
  [*] Improve swing path detection and drawing
[/list]
[h1]1.0.2[/h1]
[list]
  [*] Greatly improve hit detection accuracy, especially at smaller baseball sizes.
  [*] Other minor bug fixes
[/list]
[h1]1.0.1[/h1]
[list]
  [*] Prevent missed swings from stopping interaction in HR Derby
[/list]
